description:
Brand Introduction: New Moon is a women-owned, Australian-made brand dedicated to revolutionizing women's health. We focus on providing natural solutions to hormonal imbalances, empowering women to take control of their menstrual health.

Product Description: Our natural supplement is a carefully crafted blend of vitamins, minerals, and herbs. These ingredients are not only scientifically proven to help balance hormones but have also stood the test of time, being used in ancient medicines like Ayurveda and Chinese medicine. Designed to alleviate PMS and PMDD symptoms, it offers a holistic approach to menstrual health.

What makes us unique?

  • Natural Ingredients: Our supplement contains only natural ingredients with no artificial additives.
  • High Absorption: As a powder supplement, it boasts a 90% higher absorption rate than tablets or capsules.
  • Ancient Wisdom: Incorporates herbs and practices from Ayurveda and Chinese medicine.
  • Versatile and Convenient: With a light herbal flavor, it easily mixes into water, matcha lattes, smoothies, or tea.


Why Our Approach is Different: Western medicine often provides only band-aid solutions for PMS and PMDD, offering temporary relief without addressing the root cause. Our product is designed to be holistic, working like vitamin C for the flu – it strengthens your body's immune system and overall health. While painkillers might offer momentary relief, they don’t address your weak immune system, leading to recurring symptoms. Our supplement restores your body’s hormonal balance, banishing all the unpleasant symptoms and promoting long-term wellness.

Why Join Our Affiliate Program?

  1. Empower Women: Be a part of a mission to educate and empower women about their hormonal health.
  2. Quality You Can Trust: Promote a high-quality, natural product that's Australian-made and women-owned.
  3. Scientifically Proven: Support a product backed by both modern science and ancient wisdom.
  4. Attractive Commissions: Earn competitive commissions on every sale you generate.

Join Us: Help us spread the word about New Moon and our revolutionary natural supplement. Together, we can help women around the world experience the benefits of balanced hormones and improved menstrual health.
